description: Web security audit: security_headers_check + ssl_certificate_check + cors_test + cookie_security_audit in parallel, one grade capped by the weakest link. Deterministic by default. Name a model to add an AI review (findings ranked by exploitability, remediation roadmap, fix snippets): the audit data goes to Groq, on your api_key or the server key (10 a day per caller). ai_analysis.reason says why a review was skipped.

api_key.description: Your Groq API key, used for this request only. Without it the server key is used, 10 reviews a day.

model.description: Groq model for the optional AI review (e.g. "openai/gpt-oss-20b"). Default "none": deterministic checks only, nothing sent to a model.

name: web_security_audit
